Facts behind the days

  • Voters' Day – marks ECI's founding on 25 Jan 1950 (Article 324); observed since 2011.
  • Hindi Day – recalls the first World Hindi Conference, Nagpur, 10 Jan 1975; official since 2006.
  • Youth Day – Swami Vivekananda's birthday; Chetna Mahotsav 2026 held at Bilaspur.
  • Army Day – K.M. Cariappa took command on 15 Jan 1949.
  • Parakram Diwas – observed since 2021.
  • Pravasi Day – Gandhi returned from South Africa on 9 Jan 1915.
  • UN year – 2026 is the International Year of Rangelands and Pastoralists.
